lines: Not yoginī-born nor Rudra plainly wins this prize —
the heart of gods' own God, where swift yoga-release lies.
sanskrit_cite: etan nā yoginījāto nā rudro labhate sphuṭam | hṛdayaṃ devadevasya sadyo yogavimokṣadam

lines: At its right speaking, the great seal-host of spell
comes face to face at once, by body-possession's sign.
sanskrit_cite: asyoccāre kṛte samyaṅ mantramudrāgaṇo mahān | sadyaḥ sanmukhatām eti svadehāveśalakṣaṇam

lines: Who minds it for a moment — in the kiss, navel-sealed —
he binds then body and the mantra-seal-host.
sanskrit_cite: muhūrtaṃ smarate yas tu cumbake nābhimudritaḥ | sa badhnāti tadā dehaṃ mantramudrāgaṇaṃ naraḥ

lines: Asked, he tells the past and future — ere three hours pass,
sanskrit_cite: atītānāgatānarthān pṛṣṭo 'sau kathayaty api | praharād yad abhipretaṃ devatārūpam uccaran

lines: Face to face he sees the sure, by Rudra's powers drawn —
sky-standing in two watches' time, remembering on.
sanskrit_cite: sakṣāt paśyaty asaṃdigdham ākṛṣṭaṃ rudrasaktibhiḥ | praharadvayamātreṇa vyomastho jāyate smaran

lines: By three: all Mothers, mighty yoginī-band,
heroes, hero-lords, adepts, and the strong śākinī band.
sanskrit_cite: trayeṇa mātaraḥ sarvā yogesvaryo mahābalāḥ | vīrā vīresvarāḥ siddhā balavān śākinīgaṇaḥ

lines: They come, give pledge, by Bhairava sped —
supreme fruition grant, whatever fruit is sought.
sanskrit_cite: āgatya samayaṃ dattvā bhairaveṇa pracoditāḥ | yacchanti paramāṃ siddhiṃ phalaṃ yad vā samīhitam

lines: By this the perfected will perfect, and effect mantra-men.
sanskrit_cite: anena siddhāḥ setsyanti sādhayanti ca mantriṇaḥ

lines: Whatever in Bhairava's Tantra from this succeeds —
by mantra-potency's indwelling power, with none who leads.
sanskrit_cite: yatkiṃcid bhairave tantre sarvam asmāt prasidhyati | mantravīryasamāveśaprabhāvān na niyantriṇā
